description: Marvilene wears an opaque deep burgundy floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold and burgundy woven trim borders the neckline, front bodice seams, cuffs, waist and long skirt edges. A pale cream underdress appears through the narrow lower-front walking opening, below the knee. A cream brocade shoulder wrap with decorative gold borders rests loosely around her arms. A small gold pendant, modest earrings, bracelet and decorated waist clasp provide restrained ornaments. Brown embroidered flat shoes are visible beneath the dress. The garment covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis; there is no headgear or armor.
